name: helius-laserstream-indexer
description: Local-first Solana Microscope & Helius LaserStream gRPC indexer with multi-program/multisig monitoring, RPC failover, Anchor IDL decoding, and Prometheus/Grafana telemetry

scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:microscope
scripts.stats: tsx -e "import { DatabaseManager } from './src/db'; const db = new DatabaseManager(); db.init(); console.table(db.getStats()); db.close();"
scripts.query:txs: tsx -e "import { DatabaseManager } from './src/db'; const db = new DatabaseManager(); db.init(); console.log(JSON.stringify(db.getRecentTransactions(5), null, 2)); db.close();"
scripts.query:accounts: tsx -e "import { DatabaseManager } from './src/db'; const db = new DatabaseManager(); db.init(); console.log(JSON.stringify(db.getRecentAccounts(5), null, 2)); db.close();"
